myActivity.empty: No recent activity in this window.

byteRate.description: Recorded bytes per second; the displayed interval is explicit.
byteRate.label: Data rate

bytes.description: Recorded byte count, displayed with binary size units.
bytes.label: Data size

avgDuration.description: Existing average session duration calculation, expressed in canonical seconds.
avgDuration.label: Average session duration

energyAdded.description: Recorded energy added on included charging sessions.
energyAdded.label: Energy added

meanSessionPower.description: Arithmetic mean of finite session average powers; not peak power.
meanSessionPower.label: Mean session power

overallRate.description: Aggregate valid energy divided by corresponding positive duration; not mean session power.
overallRate.label: Overall charging rate

peakPower.description: Highest observed charging power; never a replacement for an average.
peakPower.label: Peak power

recordedCost.description: Recorded session costs, not tariff estimates or billing.
recordedCost.label: Recorded cost

sessions.description: Number of returned charging sessions included by the existing filter.
sessions.label: Sessions

count.description: Declared count, not inferred from an integer measurement.
count.label: Count

currency.description: Amount in its recorded denomination; no currency conversion.
currency.label: Cost

distance.description: Measured distance; canonical input is meters.
distance.label: Distance

duration.description: Elapsed duration; canonical input is seconds.
duration.label: Duration

efficiency.description: Consumption in watt-hours per meter; not reciprocal economy.
efficiency.label: Energy intensity

energy.description: Measured energy; canonical input is watt-hours.
energy.label: Energy

identifier.description: Source identifier, retained without grouping or rounding.
identifier.label: Identifier

latency.description: Recorded non-negative elapsed time in seconds, displayed in milliseconds or seconds.
latency.label: Latency

number.description: Unclassified numeric quantity; semantic meaning remains unknown.
number.label: Value

percent.description: Percentage input is already on the 0–100 scale.
percent.label: Percentage

power.description: Measured power; canonical input is watts.
power.label: Power

rate.description: Source-defined rate; the caller declares the quantity and time unit.
rate.label: Rate

score.description: Numeric score on a declared 100-point scale.
score.label: Score

fitStatus.description: Existing translated fit status; no invented eligibility threshold.
fitStatus.label: Fit status

inSampleRSquared.description: Existing dimensionless in-sample coefficient, not a percent.
inSampleRSquared.label: In-sample R²

includedDrives.description: Drive count admitted by the existing seasonal eligibility rules.
includedDrives.label: Included drives

observedIntensity.description: Existing observed consumption over included drives.
observedIntensity.label: Observed energy intensity

speed.description: Measured speed; canonical input is meters per second.
speed.label: Speed

status.description: Source-provided status, retained without numeric coercion.
status.label: Status

temperature.description: Absolute temperature in degrees Celsius; not a temperature difference.
temperature.label: Temperature

text.description: Source-provided text, retained without numeric coercion.
text.label: Text

brief.cadenceScope: Returned drive telemetry; valid timestamps define the observed span and adjacent-emission intervals.
brief.coverageDenominator: Availability is measured against {{count}} valid timestamp rows, not expected emissions.
brief.coverageScope: Per-signal availability in returned telemetry; missing readings are not zero measurements.
brief.description: Aggregate drive totals and sampled telemetry are independent sources; regen emissions are sample share, not time share.
brief.source: Selected drive metadata and returned telemetry emissions after the existing forward fold.
brief.window: Drive {{id}} · {{start}}–{{end}}; sampled coverage may be incomplete

context.aria: State of charge percentage and measured elevation across elapsed selected-drive emissions
context.elevationUnavailable: Elevation is unavailable for this drive; available SoC context remains visible.
context.noChannels: SoC and elevation channels are unavailable for these emissions.
context.socUnavailable: SoC is unavailable; only measured elevation context is shown.
context.subtitle: Optional context at irregular emission timestamps; elevation is shown in metres because no elevation display preference exists.
context.title: SoC & elevation context

coverage.gapWarning: The largest emission gap is more than three times the median interval; emission counts must not be interpreted as time shares.
coverage.invalidOnly: All returned rows were excluded from the analytical timeline because their timestamps were invalid.
coverage.noRows: No telemetry rows were returned for cadence or channel coverage.
coverage.partialWarning: Partial channels remain unavailable rather than being replaced with measured zero.
coverage.subtitle: Availability means a value was present after StateReader forward-folding at an emission; it does not prove a fresh measurement on every row.
coverage.timestampWarning: Invalid timestamps are excluded; duplicate timestamps are retained as separate emissions and reported explicitly.
coverage.title: Signal coverage & cadence

distributions.aria: Bar chart of drive DNA signal distribution
distributions.title: Drive DNA distribution

encoding.subtitle: Each available channel is normalized only for artwork geometry; canonical measurements remain unchanged in the analytical model.
encoding.title: Encoding legend & evidence

fingerprint.artAlt: Drive DNA deterministic emission artwork, signature {{signature}}
fingerprint.artBound: Artwork uses {{encoded}} deterministic representative emissions from {{source}} valid rows; the signature uses all valid rows.
fingerprint.neutralChannels: Unavailable speed or power channels use neutral geometry and color; they are not encoded as measured zero.
fingerprint.subtitle: A deterministic visual encoding of observed telemetry emissions—not a score or personality assessment.
fingerprint.title: Emission fingerprint

genome.noTraits: No artistic trait was assigned; unavailable speed or power never creates a substitute trait.
genome.subtitle: The signature and traits are reproducible artistic encodings of this returned telemetry—not a driving grade.
genome.title: Genome identity

kpis.capReached: The selector reached its 1,000-drive history cap; it does not truncate the selected drive’s full available telemetry emission feed or establish complete drive observations.
kpis.regenShareHint: Power-available rows after forward fold, not time share
kpis.title: Selected-drive evidence

method.capError: Selector history is unavailable; no returned-history coverage claim is made.
method.capLoading: The selector is requesting up to {{limit}} recent drives.
method.capPending: Selector-history availability has not resolved, so coverage is not yet known.
method.capReached: The selector returned the newest {{limit}} drives and reached its cap; older drives may not be selectable.
method.capScope: The selector requests up to {{limit}} recent drives; {{returned}} were returned for the current vehicle.
method.changeFeed: Rows are chronological change-feed emissions with values forward-folded by StateReader, not uniform-time samples.
method.chartBound: Charts use at most {{limit}} deterministic points while retaining the first and last; evidence metrics use all valid rows.
method.countBasis: Power states, speed bands, and regen shares are emission-count evidence, never duration or time shares.
method.noClaim: Traits are deterministic artistic heuristics—not a score, diagnosis, stable personality assessment, efficiency verdict, or causal claim.
method.powerBoundary: Response power is already canonical watts (pack voltage × current) and is used without rescaling.
method.scopeOptional: Elevation and other optional channels may be unavailable; missing values remain unavailable, never measured zero.
method.scopeSelector: The 1,000-drive cap qualifies only which drives can appear in the selector.
method.scopeTelemetry: The selected drive’s telemetry endpoint returns that drive’s full available emission feed and is not truncated by the selector cap.
method.subtitle: Scope, signal semantics, and limits for interpreting this deterministic artwork.
method.title: Coverage & methodology

powerStates.aria: Power-available telemetry emission counts classified as propulsion, coast, or regen observed
powerStates.empty: No emissions contain available power, so no power state is inferred.
powerStates.subtitle: Counts use a ±{{threshold}} {{unit}} coast band and are not duration or time shares.
powerStates.title: Power states by telemetry-emission count

profile.aria: Speed and signed pack power across elapsed selected-drive telemetry emissions
profile.noChannels: Speed and power channels are unavailable for these emissions.
profile.powerUnavailable: Power is unavailable; only measured speed emissions are shown.
profile.speedUnavailable: Speed is unavailable; only measured power emissions are shown.
profile.subtitle: Chronological emissions at their actual elapsed positions; gaps are not interpolated into uniform samples.
profile.title: Speed & power emission profile

selector.capHint: Selection history is capped at 1,000 recent drives.
selector.capReached: Newest 1,000 drives shown; older drives may be outside this selector.

list.likelyCause: Either no rules are configured yet, or every rule has evaluated cleanly in the selected window.
list.meaning: No alerts have fired — this is the expected steady state.

efficiency.likelyCause: Most often the selected range contains no completed drives — widen it before assuming data is missing.
efficiency.meaning: No efficiency figures can be computed for the selected period.

list.likelyCause: This list is empty by default — automations are opt-in and are never created for you.
list.meaning: No automations are configured, so nothing is being evaluated.

degradation.likelyCause: Most often the vehicle was linked recently, so the observation window is still too short to be meaningful.
degradation.meaning: There is not enough history yet to estimate battery degradation.

list.likelyCause: Most often the vehicle has not charged since it was linked, or it charged while asleep and unreachable.
list.meaning: No charging sessions have been recorded for this vehicle yet.

list.likelyCause: Most often the vehicle has not driven since it was linked, or the selected date range ends before the first recorded drive.
list.meaning: No completed drives have been recorded for this vehicle yet.

live.likelyCause: Most often the vehicle is asleep — Tesla stops streaming while a car sleeps, and waking it costs range.
live.meaning: No live signals are arriving for this vehicle right now.

list.likelyCause: Either setup has not been completed, or the stored Tesla authorisation was revoked and needs renewing.
list.meaning: No vehicles are linked, so nothing is being collected anywhere in the app.
